prompt: What helps protect the stomach lining?

options.text: Protective mucus and replacement of surface cells
An absence of acid inside the stomach
A wall that never loses cells

explanation: The surface produces mucus and rapidly replaces cells, maintaining a barrier facing gastric juice.

prompt: Does replacing surface cells within days mean replacing the whole stomach that quickly?

options.text: No; other gland cells are replaced more slowly
Yes; all cells in the organ have the same schedule
Yes; mucus and muscle are the same thing

explanation: That timetable concerns surface cells. Other gastric gland cells are replaced more slowly.
